periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique orientation, angled approximately 35 degrees upward from the anterior snout towards the posterior ear base.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval, with the visual longitudinal axis approximately 1.6 times the transverse width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Moderate downward tapering toward the anterior-inferior boundary, shifting the geometric center away from the eye.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Smooth U-shaped curvature along the posterior boundary of the lateral dark band.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Approximately 45% of the total visible mid-torso height.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Visible gap between ear bases, estimated at 1.5 times the width of a single pinna.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Highly smooth, semi-circular convex curvature at the superior boundary of the pinnae.
